mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions currently near Harriet Park with a temperature of 70 degrees. If you are looking to the stars tonight, the International Space Station will be visible starting at 5:43 PM; it will rise in the southwest over Mount Horeb and track high in the sky toward the Fitchburg and Madison area.

The city has a busy agenda ahead with the Plan Commission meeting on December 7th to discuss pending projects like the Liberty Business Park site plan, while the Municipal Court reminds residents that they can handle many traffic citations online or by mail without needing an in-person appearance.

There is plenty to do in town with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, performances at Lake Lou-ee and Paddy Mac's tomorrow, and a special tribute to John Denver taking place at the Verona Area High School Fine Arts Center on November 15th.
During the week of October 18th to the 24th, police handled several notable calls, including an incident on October 25th where a driver was taken into custody for an O W I offence.
Treat yourself to today's delicious Raspberry Cheesecake flavor at Culver's, which opens today at 10:00 AM.
